en_title: Rockstar Games Issues Statement as Union Vote Fails
cn_title: 工会投票未获通过，Rockstar发表声明
opus_summary: Rockstar英国员工就与IWGB游戏工作者工会达成认可协议进行投票，结果约75%反对、25%赞成，投票率为93.2%。Rockstar表示，结果反映了员工对继续保持直接沟通与合作的支持；工会则表示，即使没有正式认可协议，员工也会继续组织活动。

paragraphs.en: The Rockstar Games union vote has failed, with 75% voting against a recognition agreement with the IWGB Game Workers Union.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar的工会投票未获通过，75%的投票者反对与IWGB Game Workers Union达成承认协议。

paragraphs.en: The shock result comes following the hugely successful launch of GTA 6 , which has set records as the biggest entertainment launch of all time.
paragraphs.cn: 这一令人震惊的结果出现在《GTA 6》大获成功地推出之后，该作创下了有史以来规模最大的娱乐产品首发纪录。

paragraphs.en: Workers at Rockstar Games voted 25% in favour of and 75% against a recognition agreement with the IWGB. The terms of the recognition deal were agreed following months of negotiations that took place even as the IWGB and Rockstar clashed over the firing of 31 workers for allegedly leaking company secrets in October last year. The IWGB has alleged the workers were unlawfully fired, and have accused Rockstar Games of union busting. The vote overlapped with the closing submissions of the employment tribunal, which ended earlier this month. Judgement is currently pending.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar员工投票表决是否与IWGB达成承认协议，25%投赞成票，75%投反对票。承认协议的条款是在数月谈判后商定的，而在谈判期间，IWGB和Rockstar还就去年10月31名员工因涉嫌泄露公司机密而被解雇一事发生冲突。IWGB声称这些员工遭到非法解雇，并指责Rockstar打压工会。投票期间，雇佣法庭的庭审正在进行结案陈词，并于本月早些时候结束。目前判决尚未作出。

paragraphs.en: If the IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union had won the vote, it would have become the biggest recognised union in the UK games industry.
paragraphs.cn: 如果IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union在投票中获胜，它将成为英国游戏行业获得承认的最大工会。

paragraphs.en: The ballot saw 93.2% turnout, with 1,544 employees across Rockstar’s UK sites in Edinburgh, Leeds, Lincoln, Dundee, and London participating. 1,163 team members voted against IWGB recognition (75.3%), while 381 voted in favour (24.7%).
paragraphs.cn: 此次投票的参与率为93.2%，Rockstar位于英国爱丁堡、利兹、林肯、邓迪和伦敦各处的1,544名员工参加了投票。1,163名团队成员反对承认IWGB（75.3%），381人投了赞成票（24.7%）。

paragraphs.en: In a statement issued to IGN, Rockstar Games head of publishing, Jennifer Kolbe, said the company was “extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we've built together and the launch of GTA 6.”
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar发行负责人Jennifer Kolbe在向IGN发布的声明中表示，公司「为我们的团队、我们共同建立的文化以及《GTA 6》的推出感到无比自豪」。

paragraphs.en: “This result reflects our team's strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong,” Kolbe continued. “As we look ahead, we're excited to build on all we've accomplished together.”
paragraphs.cn: Kolbe接着说：「这一结果反映出我们的团队大力支持延续直接的关系、协作和开放的对话，正是这些帮助Rockstar变得如此富有创新力和强大。展望未来，我们期待在共同取得的一切成就之上继续发展。」

paragraphs.en: The IWGB insisted that Rockstar workers would keep organizing without a formal union recognition deal after the ballot.
paragraphs.cn: 投票结束后，IWGB坚称，即使没有正式的工会承认协议，Rockstar员工也会继续开展组织工作。

paragraphs.en: The IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union shared the following statement:
paragraphs.cn: IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union发表了以下声明：

paragraphs.en: “For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society — this isn’t a sign to retreat, it’s a sign to double down on what we stand for. Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favour of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognize we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues. We’re ready to put in the effort to make that happen.
paragraphs.cn: 「对于Rockstar所有相信应该有一个更公平的职场、更公平的行业和更公平的社会的人来说，这不是退缩的信号，而是加倍坚持我们所信奉之事的信号。数百名同事投票支持我们在Rockstar的工会，但遗憾的是，我们认识到，为了增进理解并赢得更多同事的信任，我们还有更多工作要做。我们准备好为实现这一目标付出努力。

paragraphs.en: “Whilst we haven’t emerged with a recognition deal, this ballot has put our union on the radar of every worker, and opened the door for new kinds of conversation to start happening. People entirely unfamiliar with unions were for the first time debating employment conditions, collective bargaining rights, and our contracts. We heard from many more colleagues about what mattered to them, and we hope people will continue to engage so that we can see where these new discussions can lead us.
paragraphs.cn: 「虽然我们最终没有达成承认协议，但这次投票让每位员工都注意到了我们的工会，也为开展新形式的对话打开了大门。完全不了解工会的人第一次开始讨论雇佣条件、集体谈判权和我们的合同。我们从更多同事那里听到了他们所关心的事情，我们希望大家继续参与，让我们看看这些新的讨论能将我们带向何方。

paragraphs.en: “A recognition agreement would have marked a path towards greater workplace democracy. But it’s one route of many. At Rockstar we have already won, and will continue to win, tangible changes that improve our everyday lives. We’ll keep fighting for a say. For pay transparency, contractual overtime pay, and protections against AI and layoffs.
paragraphs.cn: 「承认协议本可以开辟一条通向更大程度职场民主的道路。但这只是众多途径之一。在Rockstar，我们已经争取到了改善日常生活的切实改变，并将继续争取这样的改变。我们会继续为发言权而斗争，为薪酬透明、合同规定的加班费，以及应对人工智能和裁员的保障而斗争。

paragraphs.en: “The power to shape our working lives has always been, and will always be, in our hands.”
paragraphs.cn: 「塑造我们工作生活的权力过去始终掌握在我们手中，今后也将永远如此。」

paragraphs.en: Kolbe had indicated Rockstar’s willingness to work with staff on union recognition, recently telling Bloomberg : “We go where the team goes. So if they want a union, they will have a union.”
paragraphs.cn: Kolbe此前曾表示Rockstar愿意与员工合作处理工会承认事宜，她最近告诉彭博社：「团队选择怎样，我们就怎样。所以如果他们想要工会，他们就会有工会。」
